title_en: 69 Moon on the Way to Work
page_text_ocr_zh:
月亮在上班路上
yuè liang zài shàng bān lù shàng
page_text_en:
The Moon on the Way to Work
yuè liang zài shàng bān lù shàng
summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《月亮在上班路上》及其拼音注释。

title_en: 69 Moon on the Way to Work
page_text_ocr_zh:
那一天，月亮上班的时候，由于起得晚了一点，有点手忙脚乱，以致他走在路上时心情很不好。

月亮像往常一样，他从东边慢慢升起。他的脚步显得有点沉重，谁都看得出，月亮的心情很糟。

月亮越升越高，他慢慢走过一棵大松树的身边。按往常惯例，这时候他会低头问候一声：
“松树先生，晚上好！”

松树也会按照惯例回答一句：“月亮先生，祝你一路愉快！”

可是今天，心情不好的月亮竟然忘记问候一声，就步履沉重地从松树身边走了过去。

这让松树意外极了。因为刚才他已经把“月亮先生，祝你一路愉快”放
page_text_en:
One day, when the moon was on his way to work, he was a bit late, which made him a little flustered and anxious, so he felt very bad while walking.

As usual, the moon slowly rose from the east. His steps seemed heavy, and everyone could tell that the moon was feeling terrible.

The moon rose higher and higher, slowly passing by a big pine tree. As usual, he would bow his head and greet: 
"Mr. Pine Tree, good evening!"

The pine tree would also reply as usual: "Mr. Moon, have a pleasant journey!"

But today, the moon, feeling down, forgot to greet and walked heavily past the pine tree.

This surprised the pine tree greatly. Because just now, he had already said "Mr. Moon, have a pleasant journey!"
summary_zh: 本页描述了月亮因上班迟到而心情不好，像往常一样从东边升起，但因情绪低落而忘记向松树先生问好，这让松树感到意外。

title_en: 69 Moon on the Way to Work
page_text_ocr_zh:
在嘴边了。他不得不把这句话咽了下去，这使松树的心情也糟透了。
接下来，应该是松树向他的好朋友小松鼠说一句：‘晚安，小松鼠！’
可是，在烦恼之中的松树也忘了说这句话。
小松鼠听不到松树先生道晚安，他的心情也糟透了，以致他忘了向自己的太太道一声晚安。
……
这时，月亮已经走得很远了。他突然想起自己不应该因为心情不好，而忘了向好朋友问好。
page_text_en:
The words were on the tip of his tongue. He had to swallow them down, which made the pine tree's mood terrible too.
Next, the pine tree should have said to his good friend, the little squirrel: 'Good night, little squirrel!'
But, in his烦恼, the pine tree also forgot to say those words.
The little squirrel didn't hear Mr. Pine Tree say good night. His mood became terrible too, and he even forgot to say good night to his wife.
……
At this moment, the moon had already gone very far. He suddenly realized he shouldn't have forgotten to greet his good friend just because he was in a bad mood.
summary_zh: 松树因心情不好忘记向小松鼠道晚安，导致小松鼠也心情低落并忘了向太太问好；月亮走远后，突然意识到自己不该因心情不好而忽略朋友问候。

title_en: 69 Moon on the Way to Work
page_text_ocr_zh:
月亮赶快
回过头来，他
大声地对松
树说：“好朋友
松树先生，晚
上好！”
一听这话，松树先生的心头突
然亮了起来，他高兴地说：“月亮先
生，祝你一路愉快！”
月亮也顿时感到愉快起来，不再
心情不好了。
接下来，松树赶快向松鼠先生道
了晚安。
松鼠先生呢，也没有忘记
向他的太太道一声晚安。
……
page_text_en:
The moon quickly turned around and loudly said to the pine tree, "Good friend, Mr. Pine Tree, good evening!"
Hearing this, Mr. Pine Tree's heart suddenly lit up. He happily said, "Mr. Moon, wish you a pleasant journey!"
The moon instantly felt happy again and was no longer in a bad mood.
Next, Mr. Pine Tree quickly said goodnight to Mr. Squirrel.
Mr. Squirrel, too, didn't forget to say goodnight to his wife.
……
summary_zh: 月亮回过头向松树先生问好，松树先生因此心情变好并祝月亮一路愉快；月亮也感到愉快，随后松树向松鼠先生道晚安，松鼠先生也未忘记向太太道晚安，传递了友好的问候。

title_en: 69 Moon on the Way to Work
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，夜空下宁静又安详，洋溢着
一种快乐的气氛。
望着已经远去的月亮，松树说：
“好心情和坏心情都是会传染的。”
page_text_en:
At this moment, the night sky was peaceful and serene, filled with
a joyful atmosphere.
Looking at the moon that had already gone far away, the pine tree said:
"Good moods and bad moods are both contagious."
summary_zh: 夜空宁静安详，洋溢着快乐的气氛。松树望着远去的月亮，感慨好心情和坏心情都会传染。
